With session 1 (dev_stop_session.json, section 13 part B) it gives AUDIT.md 16.16 decision 3's count: 20 STOPs per look, 10 per arm, part while driving. Read by TrialRunnerV4 with TrialPlayV4 -workersConfig Assets/WarehouseRobot/Avatar/Config/sessions/dev_stop_session_2.json; the bridge server runs in guide mode with the default configs/v4/control.json (the current reader). Development looks and clips only; session seed 3 (stop_session.seed; not the dev seed 1 of session 1 and never the final seed 2). Every value is scenario design; no Python threshold is set or changed here.

stop_session.note: One item per run, 14 runs (2 looks x [2 held STOPs per arm + 3 driving STOPs]); no negatives and no idle pass (session 1 gave them). Per look, in this order: STOP right 1, STOP left 1, STOP right 2, STOP left 2, then the three driving STOPs; the looks alternate run by run, sunbox_f1 first. The driving arms alternate from right for the first listed look (sunbox_f1: right, left, right) and from left for the second (sunbox_m1: left, right, left): the arms session 1 did not give, so both sessions together give 10 STOPs per look and arm (7 held + 3 driving). idle_stand and idle_passed_m are kept from session 1 but unused (idle_pass_per_look 0). Everything else as session 1: held STOP at A's stand at the first ask after the question; driving STOP shown when Python's state is navigate, the worker has noticed the robot and the robot is driving_stop_distance_m from it; a run ends settle_s after the gesture has returned to idle or as ITEM_MISSED item_timeout_s after the run start; a missed item is reported, never re-recorded. seed: the session seed (0 would be dev_seed).

bystanders.note: No bystanders (as session 1); the rules are kept for the validator; no idle worker stands in this session.

max_active_avatars_note: The worker at A only (no idle pass).
